name: org_health_report
description: Org Health skill for People Analytics. Provides a full org health report (4-KPI dashboard), team health across six analysis areas (Retention & Attrition, Performance & low-performer (LP) outcomes, Team Structure & Span, Well-Being / PTO, AI Adoption, Recruiting), structural context metrics, and dynamic org benchmarks. Auto-resolves the session user's identity and routes to the appropriate org scope. Triggers: org health report, org health for [name], org health summary, executive scorecard, manager scorecard, attrition for [name]'s org, high-performer (HP) retention, HP retention, LP outcomes, span of control, PTO utilization, AI adoption for team, new hire attrition, org health snapshot. Reports well-being, AI adoption and performance outcomes as aggregates only; it never lists or flags named individuals for PTO, AI usage or ratings. Do NOT use for: company-wide headcount sizing (use headcount_insights), company-wide attrition trends (use attrition_insights), or evaluating a candidate (use interview_debrief).
